verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents database triggers or auth-event hooks that automatically run developer functions. The scheduler and crons run work on demand or on a time schedule, not in response to events. Reactive query re-execution on overlapping mutations refreshes client subscriptions; it is not a developer-defined event handler. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run functions automatically in response to database or auth events
